scripts.build:debug: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && bun build src/content.ts src/background.ts src/popup.ts --outdir=dist --target=browser --sourcemap=external && cp ./manifest.json ./style.css ./popup.html ./popup.css ./dist/ && cp -r ./icons ./dist/
scripts.build:release: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && bun build src/content.ts src/background.ts src/popup.ts --outdir=dist --target=browser --production --sourcemap=external && cp ./manifest.json ./style.css ./popup.html ./popup.css ./dist/ && cp -r ./icons ./dist/
scripts.build:firefox: rm -rf dist-firefox && mkdir -p dist-firefox && bun build src/content.ts src/background.ts src/popup.ts --outdir=dist-firefox --target=browser --sourcemap=external && cp ./style.css ./popup.html ./popup.css dist-firefox/ && cp ./manifest.firefox.json dist-firefox/manifest.json && cp -r ./icons ./dist-firefox/
scripts.build:firefox:release: rm -rf dist-firefox && mkdir -p dist-firefox && bun build src/content.ts src/background.ts src/popup.ts --outdir=dist-firefox --target=browser --production --sourcemap=external && cp ./style.css ./popup.html ./popup.css dist-firefox/ && cp ./manifest.firefox.json dist-firefox/manifest.json && cp -r ./icons ./dist-firefox/
scripts.release: bun run build:release && (cd dist && rm -f *.map && zip -r ../vifhint-$(bun -e 'console.log(require("./manifest.json").version)')-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD).zip .)
scripts.release:firefox: bun run build:firefox:release && (cd dist-firefox && rm -f *.map && zip -r ../vifhint-firefox-$(bun -e 'console.log(require("./manifest.json").version)')-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD).zip .)
scripts.fix:staged: sh -c 'test -n "$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR)" && git diff --cached --name-only -z --diff-filter=ACMR | xargs -0 biome check --write && git diff --cached --name-only -z --diff-filter=ACMR | xargs -0 biome format --write && git diff --cached --name-only -z --diff-filter=ACMR | xargs -0 git add --'
scripts.check:staged: sh -c 'test -n "$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR)" && git diff --cached --name-only -z --diff-filter=ACMR | xargs -0 biome check'
scripts.ci: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run build
